title: A note on bistability of a two-gene competitive system
summary: Self-regulation together with mutual promoter competition provides a simple mechanism for bistability in gene-regulatory models. We study a two-gene system with regulatory terms of Hill exponent one, allowing distinct basal production rates and distinct degradation rates. Each gene product, when bound to its own promoter, may enhance or reduce production relative to the basal rate, while the two products compete through promoter occupancy.
